evals.prompt: I am starting a MAUI homework app with no pages yet. Help my students build a learning book while we create a profile screen with save validation.
evals.expected_output: Select the new-project build-along mode, propose a small student-approved roadmap for the profile screen, and start with a source-grounded chapter contract in Hebrew with English code identifiers rather than dumping the whole project.

evals.prompt: Our MAUI app already has a Shell, a video list (MainViewModel.cs), SQLite services (IDatabaseService.cs), and tests. We need a guided book that gets students to a filter-and-sort goal. Decide the right steps with us first.
evals.expected_output: Inspect and map the existing project facts (MainViewModel, IDatabaseService), identify the current state and end goal, and ask the user to approve or adjust the milestone roadmap before authoring chapters.

evals.prompt: Create a step-by-step guide for this supplied dashboard design. We cannot capture an emulator, but the final learning book needs HTML snapshots and a PDF with no blank or clipped pages.
evals.expected_output: Create an HTML visual model with data-guide-overview and data-guide-block selectors, capture snapshots with Capture-Mockup-Blocks.py, clearly label the HTML model as a teaching diagram rather than emulator evidence, and require Generate-Learning-Book-Pdf.py / MAUI-Learning-Book.validation.json to pass.
